chain.absolute_note: Alle Elo-Werte sind relativ zur genannten Referenzgeneration; aus relativen Matches folgt keine absolute Elo-Zahl.
rules: A heavy step starts only with an exactly bound one-time grant (stage, run, plan hash, code fingerprint, attempt) written by the human.
Host policy v5: free RAM >= 1500 MB at the start and during the run, user idle >= 60 s, disk >= 5 GB, no competing heavy job; a match additionally needs the registered start RAM.
Budget: at most 6 CPU hours in 24 h and 30 CPU hours in 7 days (all research work together); a step reserves its largest possible booking.
Selection only by the pre-registered rule at the pre-registered looks: ACCEPTED needs the whole adjusted interval above 0, REJECTED below 0, everything else is INCONCLUSIVE (never 'equal').
A positive point estimate alone never accepts; an uncertain negative result never rejects; no early stop and no change of the limits after the fact.
Candidate limits of lineage-v1 (3 per parent, 8 generations, Bonferroni over candidates and looks) cannot be bypassed by renaming.
ACCEPTED is a state of the training lineage, not a champion change: no promotion, no tag, no master merge.
Public views never show a running, unapproved match (ARENA_OFFLINE); opening a page starts nothing.
